 Ausar Thompson (ankle) available Tuesday 
 by Chris Schommer | Pistons Correspondent | Tue, Oct 27th 2026, 7:40pm EDT 
 Ausar Thompson (ankle) is off of the injury report and available for Tuesday night’s contest between the Detroit Pistons and New York Knicks according to Hunter Patterson. ( Hunter Patterson on Twitter ) 
 Fantasy Impact: 
 Thompson returns after sitting out Sunday night’s win over the 76ers with the ankle injury suffered against the Miami Heat, boosting a versatile Detroit starting five that will look to remain undefeated with a victory over the defending champion Knicks Tuesday night.
 Ausar Thompson (right ankle sprain) is available for the Pistons against the Knicks tonight. Isaiah Joe (right hip contusion) is out.
— Hunter Patterson (@HunterPatterson) October 27, 2026
